gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Expressive and a bit wild, Funnel Display bends neon-tube strokes of constant thickness into letters, while Noto Sans Ogham keeps its tall lowercase and gapped e. Paragraphs in it feel sturdy and unhurried.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-ol-ch: Noto Sans Ol Chiki reads in solid word blocks, its curve tails held back. Give it a generous size, and let Funnel Display's looping, tubelike heading strokes stay as the one showy thing up top.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-old-h: Noto Sans Old Hungarian opens wide in its tall a, e and s, staying legible even tiny, under Funnel Display's terminals that end exactly as thick as they began. One draws attention, the other holds it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Noto Sans Oriya has generous curves and small letters nearly capital height. Funnel Display's stroke contrast is essentially zero, so the two sit together like one continuous, uncomplicated line of thought.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-osage: Inflated and friendly, with lowercase bowls that fill the line. Noto Sans Osage keeps its sweeping curves open for steady reading, while Funnel Display does the commanding work with its single monoline stroke.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-osman: Funnel Display draws every stroke like a pipe. Noto Sans Osmanya answers with oversized lowercase and wide, easy turns in its s, so headline and text feel strikingly well matched in shape.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-pahaw: Neutral and modern in tone, Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong sets a high x-height and rounds with a small gap in them. And Funnel Display sketches its headings as a thread of ink, never swelling or tapering.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-palmy: Noto Sans Palmyrene reads compact and crisp, with short ascenders and curves that stop before closing in. Funnel Display above it keeps one unbroken line weight, so the page holds together.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-pau-c: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau reads cleanly, its open-ended curves given room and its capitals only a short step above lowercase. Over many lines, Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau feels relaxed and modern against Funnel Display's heavy tubing.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-phags: Noto Sans PhagsPa reads light and approachable, with openings you can see through and capitals rising only slightly above the small letters. Funnel Display's flat curves lend it a long, easy flow.
